guarantee: no template in src/ticker.py contains a literal digit -- checked at import time and again by verify() -- so every number rendered here arrived in an event payload from a file the agent wrote

perceive.fortyguard.template: Read {n_pairs:,} FortyGuard forecast-and-outcome day pairs measured at {pairs_site}, {n_tiles:,} tiles per call, at forecast leads from {lead_min:.2f} to {lead_max:.2f} h.
perceive.fortyguard.short: reading {n_pairs:,} FortyGuard day-pairs from {pairs_site}, {n_tiles:,} tiles each

perceive.own_window.template: This site has its own purchased FortyGuard window: {n_tiles_own:,} tiles. One past window, not a day-pair -- there is no forecast leg beside it, so it cannot yield a level offset or a coverage figure, and the bound below is still borrowed.
perceive.own_window.short: reading its own purchased window, {n_tiles_own:,} tiles

perceive.site_tile.template: The committed site falls inside a tile whose centre lies {dist_m:.0f} m away; on {tile_date} that tile read {tile_c:.2f} C.
perceive.site_tile.short: locating the site inside its tile, {dist_m:.0f} m off centre

perceive.borrowed_field.template: No FortyGuard field was purchased for {site}, so the level term is {donor}'s measured offset and the coverage record is {donor}'s. This site's weather, geometry, plume solves and hours are entirely its own.
perceive.borrowed_field.short: no FortyGuard field of its own at {site}

perceive.record.template: Loaded {n_hours:,} real station hours over {n_days:,} days -- the record every margin below is fitted on, and none of it is synthetic.

solve.table.template: Solved the steady advection-diffusion field {n_solves:,} times on the committed footprints, {n_bearings:,} wind bearings by {n_speeds:,} speeds, in {solve_s:.2f} s on {device}.

solve.worst.template: Worst intake rise {worst_c:.4f} C, at {worst_bearing:.0f} deg and {worst_speed:.1f} m/s; averaged over the whole table it is {mean_c:.4f} C.
solve.worst.short: worst intake rise {worst_c:.4f} C at {worst_bearing:.0f} deg

solve.none.template: No plume was solved: the nearest other tagged data centre is {nearest_m:,} m away, outside the {range_m:,} m range this solver has been validated against, so there is no neighbour intake for a plume to arrive at. Recirculation is NOT MODELLED here, which is a statement about the model's domain and not a claim that it is zero.
solve.none.short: no plume solved -- nearest other data centre {nearest_m:,} m away

solve.refuse.template: Declined to answer on {n_refused_long:,} of {n_bearings:,} bearings with the condenser bank on the long facade, and {n_refused_face:,} of {n_bearings:,} with it on the facing wall, because a building stands on the source-to-intake path and a transparent building cannot deflect what a real one would. Where that guard fires the agent's five-year advantage falls to {refusal_cost_h:+.1f} h a year, so the headline rests on the bank sitting on the long facade.
solve.refuse.short: refusing {n_refused_long:,} of {n_bearings:,} bearings it cannot stand behind

bound.level.template: Split conformal on the agent's own record: n = {n:,} day-level residuals, order statistic k = {k:,}, margin {margin_c:+.4f} C. Clamped to the largest residual in the sample: {clamped}.

bound.ceiling.template: With n = {n:,} calibration days the attainable coverage is capped at {ceiling_pct:.1f} % against a nominal {nominal_pct:.0f} %; reaching the nominal needs {n_needed:,} days.
bound.ceiling.short: coverage ceiling {ceiling_pct:.1f} % at this sample size

bound.mondrian.template: Group-conditional quantiles by hour of day run {q_min:.2f} to {q_max:.2f} C at {notice_h:,} h notice, smallest group {smallest_n:,} rows. One pooled quantile instead would leave {n_below:,} of {n_groups:,} hours under nominal, the worst at {worst_pct:.2f} %.

decide.sweep.template: Planned {n_scen:,} scenarios across {n_axes:,} swept plant-envelope axes plus forecast skill. {pct_zero:.1f} % of them declare zero free-cooling hours, which on the hottest days is the correct answer.
decide.sweep.short: planning {n_scen:,} scenarios across the plant envelope

decide.days.template: On the real FortyGuard days: {n_dec:,} declarations, {n_free:,} of them free cooling, {n_unsafe:,} of those unsafe.

decide.days_vacuous.template: On the real FortyGuard days: {n_dec:,} declarations and {n_free:,} of them free cooling. Those days ran {t_min:.1f} to {t_max:.1f} C against a highest limit of {limit_max:.1f} C, so zero is the physical answer and the {n_unsafe:,} unsafe declarations prove nothing about safety. What these days do test is the bound.
decide.days_vacuous.short: declaring {n_free:,} of {n_dec:,} free -- too hot for any controller

act.commands.template: Emitted {n_rows:,} command rows over {n_blocks:,} case-and-limit combinations, bounds from {b_min:.3f} to {b_max:.3f} C. Every row states the bound it acted on.
act.commands.short: emitting {n_rows:,} command rows, each carrying its bound

score.sequential.template: Scored out of sample against what elapsed: {cov_pct:.1f} % pooled coverage over {n_test:,} test days, worst single day {worst_pct:.1f} %.
score.sequential.short: scoring itself: {cov_pct:.1f} % coverage on held-out days

score.verdict.template: Against conditions fixed before any outcome existed -- pooled coverage at or above {p1_pct:.0f} %: {p1}. No test day below {p2_pct:.0f} %: {p2}. At least {p3_n:,} test days: {p3}. Overall {verdict}.

recalibrate.moved.template: The margin moved itself, most sharply after the {trigger_date} miss: {before_c:+.4f} C on {before_days:,} day-pairs became {after_c:+.4f} C on {after_days:,}, a {direction} of {delta_c:+.4f} C that no human applied.
recalibrate.moved.short: widening its own margin by {delta_c:+.4f} C, unprompted

recalibrate.online.template: Online recalibration over {rounds:,} real rounds carried realised coverage from {static_cov:.4f} to {aci_cov:.4f} against a {nominal_pct:.0f} % nominal.

hour.perceive.template: {hour_label}: the forecast for this hour is {fc_c:.3f} C dry-bulb and {fc_dp_c:.3f} C dew point, issued {notice_h:,} h ahead at {skill:.2f} of the skill of persistence.

hour.solve.template: Wind from {bearing_deg:.0f} deg at {wind_kt:.1f} kt. The solved recirculation adds {rise_c:.4f} C to the intake -- {rise_pct:.1f} % of the headroom under the limit.

hour.solve_no_headroom.template: Wind from {bearing_deg:.0f} deg at {wind_kt:.1f} kt. The solved recirculation adds {rise_c:.4f} C, on top of an ambient already {over_c:.3f} C above the limit -- there is no headroom for it to be a fraction of.

hour.solve_calm.template: Calm hour: the station reports no bearing, so the agent takes the worst rise over every bearing it is still allowed to compute, {rise_c:.4f} C.

hour.solve_refused.template: Refused: at {bearing_deg:.0f} deg a building stands between the condensers and the intake, so there is no rise the solver can stand behind. Falling back to mechanical.

hour.bound.template: Margin {margin_c:.4f} C = {shape_c:.4f} C of group-conditional forecast error for this hour of day, plus {plume_c:.5f} C of plume-ensemble spread, plus {level_c:.4f} C of FortyGuard level. Upper bound on intake air {bound_c:.3f} C.

hour.decide_free.template: {bound_c:.3f} C against the {limit_c:.1f} C limit leaves {slack_c:.3f} C of room, so the hour is certified safe.

hour.decide_blocked.template: {bound_c:.3f} C against the {limit_c:.1f} C limit is over by {short_c:.3f} C, so the hour is not certified. Binding constraint: {binding}.

hour.act_switch.template: Command {command}, a change of mode: {n_used:,} of {budget:,} changes now spent, and the plant must hold this mode {dwell_h:,} h.

hour.act_hold.template: Command {command}, unchanged from the hour before: {n_used:,} of {budget:,} mode changes spent so far.

hour.score.template: What actually happened: {truth_c:.3f} C at the intake. The bound sat {gap_c:.3f} C {side} it, so this hour {covered}.

hour.recalibrate.template: This hour is one row of the record the margin is fitted from: {n_shape:,} persistence hours at this notice, split across {n_groups:,} hour-of-day groups.
